oneLine: Indiabulls acquires a fintech business valued at ₹1,500 crore.

sources.title: What Is Indiabulls Really Buying? How Does A Fintech With Nil Disclosed Turnover In The Previous Two Years Become A ₹1,500 Crore Business And Why Are Shareholders Being Asked To Take The Deal On Trust?

synopsis: Indiabulls is proposing to acquire a 70% majority stake in privately held fintech company Fintech Cloud for ₹1,050 crore. The transaction values the target company at an implied equity value of ₹1,500 crore. The acquisition consideration is proposed to be paid largely through the issue of up to 21 crore new shares by the listed buyer, Indiabulls. Fintech Cloud reported revenue of ₹133.77 crore and a profit before tax of ₹30.31 crore for FY26, following two preceding financial years of nil disclosed turnover. The proposed deal will alter the ownership structure of the listed acquiring company by placing substantial shareholder capital behind the future operations of Fintech Cloud.
